name: Strudel
prior: Oli Larkin Endless Series v3 (VST/AU/AAX, 2008/2011): additive Shepard generator up to 40 partials, continuous glissando and MIDI-stepped modes, 14 scales, harmonicity/timbre, ring-mod/flanger/phaser modes (VS: olilarkin.co.uk, kvraudio.com/product/endless-series-by-oli-larkin, sonicstate 2011/06/01) = closest product, desktop. Jean-Francois Charles Shepard Risset Synth (Max for Live, 2020, GPL): Shepard tones and Risset glissandi from MIDI, legato = glide from held note to new one, filter, sine-to-noise, drive (VS: jeanfrancoischarles.com/2020/07, newfloremusic.gumroad.com) = 'Glockenmitte = gespielte Note' and glide between notes as a playable instrument. Ableton abl.dsp.shepard~ (Max object): depth, direction, rate < 0.5 falls / 0.5 still / > 0.5 rises (VS: docs.cycling74.com) = Strudel's exact Hoehe mapping as a stock object. Make Noise tELHARMONIC 'Spiratone' hidden mode: Eurorack Shepard voice up and down (VS: makenoisemusic.com manual, modulargrid forum). DSP Concepts Audio Weaver ShepardToneGenerator (VS: dochub.dspconcepts.com); Kyma ShepardContinuousSpectrum (VS: symbolicsound); Korg R3/RADIAS 'Endless' waveform and Kurzweil K250 endless glissando (VS: synthtopia, unconfirmed); mda Shepard (free VST, early 2000s, A); risers/effects Perpetual Motion, gd-shepringmod, The Shepard, Shepard Designer (VS); patches/code CNMAT shepard.js, cycling74 Risset article, VCV thread, Jordan Eldredge Web Audio demo (~40 lines, auto-loop), CRIWARE explainer (VS). Risset rhythm: Risset Metronome (iPad 2022, Sporkl), Risset Rhythm Generator (web, Tone.js, 2026), tmhglnd/risset-rhythm-effect, snappizz SC example (VS). iOS Harmonizer (educational), Ring Pipe Organ 2009 (VS). Not found: a touch instrument where finger height sets direction and speed per voice with chroma anchored to the played note and a Risset-rhythm tremolo coupled to the glissando speed; and no instrument with non-octave (tritave/golden-ratio) Shepard spacing - the genuinely new variant.
costNotes: Worklet budget (R: webaudio.md section 4/8): node 0.06 + 3 k-rate params 0.09 = 0.15 base; per table-sine partial (phase acc + lerp read + amp MAC) ~0.045 -> 6 partials ~0.3; farbe row at 3*f_k via sin 3x = 3s - 4s^3 from the same sample +0.1; cos^2 amplitudes, increments and tremolo layers per block. L1 ~0.55-0.6 (idea 0.4 optimistic by ~1.5x), phone x1-1.5 -> <= 0.9. L3: 9 partials x 2 sets +-4 ct + farbe + stereo ~1.4 (idea 0.8); Obertoene class 0.75/1.85 (APP 2081-2082), below Gong 1.55. Native alternative is cheaper than the idea thinks (6 osc + 6 gain + out ~13 nodes ~0.4 units, not 1.5-2) but brittle: each partial needs a linear detune ramp plus a setValueCurveAtTime cos^2 gain whose zero must coincide with a 7200-ct jump; every setY and Gestik offset (~30/s) reschedules 12 params with cancelAndHoldAtTime whose cross-browser semantics for curves are unreliable; one mistimed wrap = click. Contract fits (R: section 10): detune bus -> one k-rate detune for all partials, envelopes native on v.out.gain, freq glide = window centre glide. Geometry: N = 6 partials wrap every 6 octaves so breite <= N/2 = 3 (L1) / 4.5 (L3) or a partial wraps while audible (click); the idea's 1-3.5 breaks at L1; breite < ~1.5 leaves 2-3 audible partials and the illusion collapses. Clamp partials above 0.45*SR (centre 1.5 kHz, breite 2.2, farbe 3x -> 20.7 kHz aliasing). Smooth the tremolo base rate over ~0.5 s on seq.bpm change.
soundHeld: Unmistakable as a held note: the endless rise/fall is recognised in two seconds, two fingers at opposite heights give contrary endless motion, tilt-forward = whole chord rises. But at Hoehe-Mitte the engine is a static stack of 4-5 sines at octave spacing - a sine organ with no noise, attack, formant or motion, unlike every other held Myzel engine; needs idle life at L1 (slow +-0.03 oct/s breathing of phi, the +-4 ct pair at L1 too, or farbe > 0 by default). Hoehe is consumed by direction/speed so timbre does not follow finger height - a convention break unless |y - 0.5| also opens farbe. Any Gestik Hoehe offset moves the dead zone: a held note always drifts under tilt (document it). Chords get muddy: each finger is a 6-octave stack, 3 fingers a third apart = 15 sines with octave-crossing beats plus 18 farbe partials, L3 pairs double it; fine for two fingers, mud at four, 4 x 0.6 = 2.4 units.
soundBurst: Weak: Puls gate = 0.9*step (APP 5980), 1/16 at 120 bpm = 112 ms; burst rate 8*tempo = 2.4 oct/s decaying to 0 over the gate -> ~0.13-0.27 octave of sweep, a soft sine chirp without transient = a quieter Tropfen. 'Jede Lane ein Accelerando, das nie ankommt' needs a tremolo at 2-8 Hz, i.e. gates >= 0.5 s; false for 1/8 and 1/16 patterns. Fix: burst rate independent of tempo (15-40 oct/s, direction from Hoehe -> a 'Riss'/zip with octave-stacked partials) or accept Strudel as a drone engine with a secondary Puls role. Phone speakers break the seam: the lower 2-3 octaves of a window centred on A3 are inaudible, the listener hears a periodic reset instead of a seamless climb; on speaker centre the window an octave above the note or narrow breite.
failureModes: Dead zone = static sine organ at Hoehe-Mitte; needs idle life and a timbre axis
Puls hits show no illusion (112 ms gate = 0.2 octave chirp); burst needs its own fast 'Riss' rate
Phone speakers lose the low octaves -> periodic reset instead of seamless climb
Cliche risk: trailer riser / stock Max object; distinctive != new; non-octave (tritave/morphable) spacing would be the real novelty at the same cost
Chords get muddy beyond two fingers; 4 x 0.6 = 2.4 units
Tilt means it never stands still (document); breite must be capped at N/2 and partials clamped below 0.45*SR
verdict: Rare, not new: the Shepard-Risset glissando is sold as a MIDI-playable plugin (Endless Series), free as an M4L instrument with Risset glide between notes (Shepard Risset Synth), a stock Ableton/Max object with Strudel's exact 'below/above/centre' rate mapping (abl.dsp.shepard~), and a hidden Eurorack mode (tELHARMONIC Spiratone); only the finger-height direction and the coupled Risset tremolo are unfound. Feasible as a worklet at about 0.6 (L1) / 1.4 (L3) units, not 0.4 / 0.8, with breite capped at N/2 and a Nyquist clamp. Musically it is a strong drone/Gestik engine but a weak Puls hit (112 ms gate = 0.2 octave of chirp), and at the centre it is a sterile sine organ; keep it only if the dead zone gets idle life, the burst gets its own fast 'Riss' rate, and ideally the spacing is made non-octave (tritave/morphable), which is where the real novelty would be.
